//: CTO V55 — P3 CRA/SBOM E4→E5 transition criteria. P3 STAYS at E4 until EVERY condition below is met=true AND an independent controller signs off. E5 requires a real authorised client, real product manifests, a lawful access basis, a REAL CVE scan (the guard performs license audit only), observed/verifiable results, written client validation and qualified legal confirmation. ODG prepares readiness evidence; it NEVER certifies CRA conformity, gives legal advice, or guarantees compliance.
title: CRA / SBOM supply-chain readiness

e4Evidence.basis: SBOM/gate/sealed-bundle are real composition over SYNTHETIC manifests; vulnerabilities/incidents/timelines SIMULATED (cveScan NOT_PERFORMED) — never observed, never conformity, never certification

transitionConditions.condition: A real client/manufacturer explicitly authorises an engagement (signed scope by the owner).
Product perimeter and responsibilities written (which product/version; who owns reporting/CE/conformity).
Lawful basis and access to the real software inventory (manifests/lockfiles/tech doc) established — minimised, documented.
Real execution: SBOM over REAL manifests + a REAL CVE scan against an offline feed (the guard performs license audit only).
Observed, verifiable results: real vulnerabilities (not simulated), sealed+signed evidence pack, tamper-evidence re-verified.
Qualified legal confirmation of CRA obligations, reporting duties and dates (ODG does not give legal advice).
Written client validation of the findings and remediation plan.
Independent controller review of the whole engagement (ODG retains authority; Claude Code = technical provider only).

acceptanceCriteria: A REAL CVE scan replaces the SIMULATED vulnerability set; at least one OBSERVED-basis evidence item present.
Sealed evidence pack signed and tamper-evidence re-verified (bundle + pack).
Independent evidence digest verifies (O2.verifyEvidence ok) over the real deliverable.
Controller sign-off + qualified legal confirmation + written client validation recorded.
rejectionCriteria: The report presented as CRA conformity, certification, or a legal opinion.
Any vulnerability claimed without a real CVE scan (SIMULATED must stay SIMULATED).
A recommendation presented as a legal obligation.
An UNKNOWN/conditional license assumed safe (must stay needsReview).
Data/code accessed without a documented lawful basis, or no independent controller review.
regulatoryPosture: ODG prepares CRA/SBOM readiness evidence (SBOM + license gate + sealed pack). CRA reporting (24h/72h/14-day from 2026-09-11) and main obligations (2027-12-11) are owner-operated legal duties; dates are data to be confirmed by qualified counsel. NOT a certification, NOT legal advice, NOT a CVE scan.
invariant: Until all conditions are met=true, P3 remains E4 and e5Status remains NOT_STARTED. Simulated vulnerabilities/timelines are NEVER presented as observed or conformity. ODG keeps authority; an independent controller and qualified legal expertise are mandatory.
nonGoals: No prospecting, no external message, no contract, no spend, no subscription, no hiring.
No CRM or parallel registry — reuse the nine primitives, P3 guard, O1/O2, evidence-provenance, existing evidence.
No push, merge, deployment or VPS access; no background process; no npm privilege escalation.
